title: Turn off CRM Pulse collection while an admin is impersonating, and prove nothing is stored
recorded_defect: Owner decision 2026-09-17: activity while an admin is impersonating someone must not be recorded, the same as employee preview (b9b780d). The first attempt (run crm-pulse-impersonation-exclusion) showed that main.py enforce_impersonation_read_only already answers 403 to every non-read request while session['impersonator_id'] is set, so impersonated Pulse events are rejected before ingest and never stored. The remaining gap is on the page: templates/base.html still sets data-crm-telemetry to 'on' while impersonating, so the collector keeps sending events that are refused. Nothing proves impersonated activity stays out of Pulse.
objective:
CRM Pulse must record nothing while an admin is impersonating another user, as it already records nothing during employee preview. A session is impersonating when session.get('impersonator_id') is not None; blueprints/auth.py sets it when an admin starts viewing as another user.

The server side already holds: main.py enforce_impersonation_read_only answers 403 to POST /api/owner-pulse/events while impersonating, so events are never stored. Do not change that, and do not change main.py, blueprints/crm_pulse.py, services/crm_pulse.py, blueprints/auth.py or any other file except the two below.

1. templates/base.html: make the body attribute data-crm-telemetry 'off' while impersonating, using session.get('impersonator_id') is not none (Jinja spelling), in addition to the existing employee_preview condition. Keep everything else byte-identical, including the literal text data-crm-telemetry-endpoint="/api/owner-pulse/events" and data-crm-page-key="{{ request.endpoint or '' }}", which tests assert. Do not change script tags.

2. Write tests/test_crm_pulse_impersonation.py (pytest, with the fixtures in tests/conftest.py). The impersonating session must be a real admin impersonating a DIFFERENT, non-admin user: look both users up from the conftest fixture data (for example the admin and an employee such as va@test.local), set session['_user_id'] to the employee's id and session['impersonator_id'] to the admin's id through client.session_transaction(), as tests/test_gallery_sources_grant_workspace.py does. Use a same-origin Referer such as http://localhost/accounts and pageKey employees.accounts, matching tests/test_crm_pulse.py. Show:
(a) a valid events batch posted by the impersonating session is not stored: the response is not 2xx and no CRMPulseEvent rows exist afterwards for either the employee or the admin;
(b) the same batch posted by a normal, non-impersonating session of the same employee returns 201 and stores the events for that employee;
(c) a rendered authenticated page that returns 200 for that employee (try /dashboard, then /accounts) contains data-crm-telemetry="off" while impersonating and data-crm-telemetry="on" in the normal session.
Clear CRMPulseEvent rows at the start of each test. You cannot run pytest yourself; the harness runs it.
verification_note: Replaces crm-pulse-impersonation-exclusion, whose objective assumed ingest could return 202 while impersonating; the global read-only guard answers 403 first. Known residual, out of scope: impersonation still refreshes the impersonated user's users.last_activity (the session idle timeout reads it), so Pulse's session-based people list can show that user as connected.
